title: Day 23 — she snaps, then it lifts (PMDD)
caption:
Two good weeks, then you're a stranger to yourself? That's PMDD — about 1 in 20 women (IAPMD). Track mood + cycle day for 2 cycles; that record is what gets you care. Send this to her. Which day hits hardest?
www.aiforheratx.org
#pmdd #pmddawareness #womenshealth #cycletracking #hormonehealth

scenes.text: Two good weeks. Then I *snap* at everyone I love.

scenes.text: About 1 in 20 women live with PMDD — a listed diagnosis, not a bad attitude. (IAPMD)
In a 1998 NEJM trial, women with PMS had normal hormone levels — their brains reacted differently to normal shifts.
phrases: Her bloodwork was normal. Of course it was.
Researchers switched hormones off — symptoms lifted.
Added them back and the symptoms returned.
Normal levels, a brain that reacts. NEJM, 1998.

scenes.text: Tonight: rate mood 1-10 with your cycle day in your notes app, and walk 20 minutes tomorrow.
phrases: Tonight: mood 1-10 + cycle day, in your notes app.
Keep it for two cycles — that record is what a doctor can act on.
Add 20 min of walking most days (WHO: 150 min a week).
